propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the last_get_pass inline field must be absent from bindings.json entries while the sidecar get_rotation.json contains the chronological maximum and rotation order is preserved on reload.

When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline fallback retained; a subsequent successful save must promote the maximum to get_rotation.json before removing the inline field.

A failure after sidecar replace but before bindings replace cannot lose rotation state: the maximum remains durable in sidecar and a fresh reload observes it before later convergence to sidecar-only form.

An old-writer/new-writer sequence that reintroduces a later inline stamp must migrate that maximum into get_rotation.json, remove the inline field, and preserve the same rotation order as an all-new sequence.

BindingStore must merge every staged inline value into the in-memory sidecar using chronological max, atomically persist get_rotation.json first, then only remove inline last_get_pass and atomically write bindings.json on sidecar persistence success.

The deployment gate must record A2-1 merge SHA, a descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run with successful ancestry proof, an explicitly refreshed host probe binary version, and confirmation that no older reconcile/probe process remains.
